categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Vercel Edge Network hosting with HTTP/2 and HSTS preload
Clean 404 response handling for nonexistent paths
Canonical tags present across all pages

findings.title: Multi-Hop Canonical Redirect Chains on HTTP & Legacy URLs
findings.description: http://aegi.ca redirects through two 308 hops before reaching https://www.aegi.ca/. Legacy service URLs also suffer from intermediate hops.
findings.recommendation: Collapse redirect rules in next.config.js to direct 1-hop 301/308 redirects to https://www.aegi.ca/*.

findings.title: Mobile Horizontal Overflow at 375px Viewport
findings.description: Headless browser testing revealed document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth at 375px viewport width.
findings.recommendation: Clamp parent container max-widths to 100vw and add overflow-x: hidden to prevent horizontal scrolling.

findings.title: Heading Hierarchy Skips and Footer Non-Semantic Headings
findings.description: Homepage skips from H1 directly to H3, and H2 directly to H4. Footer navigation columns use H4 headings instead of semantic nav elements.
findings.recommendation: Restructure headings sequentially (H1 -> H2 -> H3) and replace footer headings with styled p tags inside nav containers.

findings.title: Root Canonical Tag Missing Trailing Slash
findings.description: Homepage declares canonical https://www.aegi.ca while Google serves https://www.aegi.ca/.
findings.recommendation: Update metadata.alternates.canonical to include the trailing slash https://www.aegi.ca/.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Prominent APEGA and NAPEG professional engineering permit holder badges
Dedicated individual P.Eng team member profile pages with biographical details
High information density with zero generic AI filler patterns detected

findings.title: High Micro-copy Repetition Across Service Cards
findings.description: Content tokenization detected 61% repetition index on the homepage due to duplicate phrase structures across service cards.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate service micro-copy with concrete project examples, municipal compliance details, and specific tooling.

findings.title: Missing Blog-to-Service Internal Linking Bridges
findings.description: 13 technical blog posts receive organic impressions but lack in-content contextual links pointing to commercial service landing pages.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual editorial links and inquiry callouts in every blog post pointing to relevant service pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Comprehensive ProfessionalService, Organization, and WebSite schemas
APEGA Permit to Practice credential schema explicitly declared
BreadcrumbList structured data validated across service pages

findings.title: Directional Conflict on Nested Review Schema
findings.description: Google Search Console URL Inspection raised 4 warnings: 'A nested parent node object cannot contain the itemReviewed field.'
findings.recommendation: Remove itemReviewed from individual reviews nested directly inside ProfessionalService.

findings.title: Deprecated FAQPage Rich Result Schema
findings.description: Commercial service pages declare 4.4KB FAQPage schema which Google no longer awards rich snippet results to for commercial sites.
findings.recommendation: Retain FAQs in user HTML but replace FAQPage schema with structured Service and Offer catalog markup.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Fast TTFB powered by Vercel edge caching (X-Vercel-Cache: HIT)
Modern AVIF image format utilized across all service and badge assets

findings.title: Service Card Images Missing Explicit Width and Height Attributes
findings.description: Service card images have width: None and height: None, increasing risk of Cumulative Layout Shift before hydration.
findings.recommendation: Provide explicit aspect-ratio CSS or explicit width/height dimensions on all image wrappers.

findings.title: No Conversion CTA Visible Above 1080px Desktop Fold
findings.description: Visual analysis confirms hero headline is visible but primary action buttons fall below standard above-the-fold cutoff.
findings.recommendation: Elevate primary 'Request a Quote' button directly beneath hero subheadline.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & GEO
what_works: Active llms.txt (5.0KB) and llms-full.txt (7.7KB) passing all Lighthouse rules
Explicit robots.txt allow rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended
Server-rendered HTML fully extractable without JavaScript execution

findings.title: Missing Accept: text/markdown Content Negotiation
findings.description: Individual service and blog URLs do not offer Markdown representations for agentic consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement Next.js edge route handling for Accept: text/markdown requests.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images feature descriptive, keyword-aligned alt text
Next.js image optimization pipeline active with modern AVIF delivery

findings.title: Oversized Source Width Queries on Card Thumbnails
findings.description: Card images query w=3840 parameters in Next.js image loader for 350px display slots.
findings.recommendation: Tune sizes prop in next/image to accurately represent card column constraints (e.g. (max-width: 768px) 100vw, 350px).

Align root canonical tag with server trailing slash (https://www.aegi.ca/)
